title: Sallie Mae Announces Pricing Terms of Tender Offer for Its 3.125% Senior Notes Due 2026
summary: Sallie Mae ® (Nasdaq: SLM), formally SLM Corporation (“ SLM ” or the “ Company ”), announced today the pricing terms of its previously announced cash tender offer (the “ Tender Offer ”) to purchase any and all of its outstanding 3.125% senior notes (the “ Notes ”) upon the terms and conditions described in the Company’s Offer to Purchase, dated May 6, 2026 (the “ Offer to Purchase ”).
